reviewDecisionRule: keep/maybe/reject is a source-selection note only. Only a completed pass through sourceApprovedRequires may change a source to source-approved.

reviewEvidence.rule: Only V2 reviewer exports with SHA-256 bindings matching the committed receipts/shortlist are valid evidence input. Main/extension and field normalizers both preserve an explicitly unapproved evidence status and cannot promote source approval.

focus: South Carolina beach source: whether usable coastal wind exists without surf becoming the wrong semantic layer
cricket noise floor and biome fit
thunder perceived proximity, transient/tail and headroom risk
gull codec artifacts, call isolation and shore/island fit
Fisterra gust segmentation, contamination and genuinely distinct attacks/bodies/tails
Guadeloupe rainforest walking/handling noise, close-bird dominance and stable deep-bed regions
reviewGroups.decisionRule: keep/maybe/reject is source-selection evidence only; source-approved remains a separate gate

requiredListeningChecks.question: Voices, traffic, birds, room tone, handling noise or unrelated events that conflict with the island context?
Does the sound read as the intended material/action at normal level without relying on filename knowledge?
Can useful loop regions or clean one-shots be derived without obvious repeated artifacts?
Is noise/hiss acceptable for the intended use after normal game gain staging?
Are important transients unclipped and useful for editing?
Does the recording contain obvious indoor/outdoor or distance character that conflicts with intended use?
Does this source provide enough distinct material for non-repeating variants or layering?
For loops/beds, is there avoidable dense midrange energy likely to mask partner/radio speech?

technicalChecks: record actual codec/sample rate/channels/bit depth from technicalProbe
do not overwrite the acquired original
record every edit/resample operation used for a derived master
preserve selected archive member SHA-256 before any extraction-derived edit
avoid repeated lossy transcodes when a selected source member is Vorbis/OGG
for field sources, preserve the exact receipt target and evidence-run binding used by the human review export

sourceApprovedRequires: all applicable required listening checks completed
derivedMasterApprovedRequires: listening QA repeated on derived file

runtimeBoundary: Claude owns final Unity mix, spatialization, ducking, compression/import settings and device listening QA.
